lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to draw Jerusalem on a brick and set up an iron plate as a wall.
Ezekiel lies on his left side for 390 days to bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
Ezekiel then lies on his right side for 40 days to bear Judah's iniquity, and God ties him up with chains.
Ezekiel makes bread from six grains in a single container and weighs out twenty shekels of it daily.
God lets Ezekiel bake his bread over cow dung, and Jerusalem will eat bread rationed by tribe.
